But you cannot complete it, there is a missing arrow at one point and then you simply …. Cannot use the product. Such an embarrassingly overengineered app.

reviews.title: Lack of functionality
reviews.text:
I just paid 300$ for an app with less functionality than sleep numbers from 10 years ago. 

It doesn’t allow edits or modifications. It doesn’t let you tell it you were awake just in bed. Its notifications systems need work. 


The physical product is great. The app is criminal.  Support line has screwed up my request for 2 months ago I’m not thrilled there ever.

reviews.title: Bed amazing, app improving
reviews.text:
I’m thrilled with the hardware and recent app changes. Including old review for the team - the new customization options resolved my issues and I even found the smart alarm feature…really useful! 

—Old review below—

After more than seven years of recommending our Eight Sleep to everyone who would listen, we’re ready to find a new product.

The hardware is great. The app has become progressively worse.

In the early years, I actually woke up excited to open the app. It gave me exactly the data I wanted to track day to day and helped me understand how my habits affected my sleep.

Now I dread opening it. I wait for an AI summary I don’t need while the useful data is buried in graphs and takes more clicks to reach.

The latest gimmick is “Biological Age,” which means I can now wake up to an alarming red “You’re trending older” because a metric moved slightly from the week before.

I was a UX designer and UX Director for 20 years. I understand the intention: engagement and unique value. But Eight Sleep already had engagement. I wanted to open the app every morning because the data was useful.

Telling me I’m “getting older” based on short-term fluctuations is meaningless and stressful. Just give me my sleep data so I can understand what changed and why.

I’m tired of updates that bury useful information under features designed to drive engagement. After seven years as a customer, we’ll be looking elsewhere when it’s time to upgrade.

reviews.title: Please update
reviews.text: Hi, I’ve had multiple 8 sleep for years and I love it but I have a dog that messes my sleep score because he lays on the bed when I’m not home, it would be great if you would implement an update to change or specify “edit sleep” sessions. It used to work, but now it’s changed and I can’t just simply get rid of my pets extra sleep hours. The solution is not “don’t let your dog on the bed” this is an expensive product and I’ve had multiple line ups and am requesting for a better editable sleep sessions or a “pet” toggle.

reviews.title: Must have for parents

My wife bought this for us a month ago and I already see the difference in my sleep, recovery and energy levels. Your health is the one thing in your life completely in your control! I cannot say enough good things about this sleep system.

I used to wonder why people were nerds about data and I finally get it. Optimizing your sleep and using AI to analyze through sensors/real data can actually help you lead a more productive daytime and potentially lengthen your life.

reviews.text: I renewed my subscription and was charged $199 but the app didn’t recognize my subscription. I only ever used one email, one account, one phone, so it’s really concerning that their software has these issues. When reaching out to support I got a bunch of outdated instructions from AI that didn’t work. It was frustrating. I get the feeling that their software is heavily vibe-coded.

reviews.title: Like Sleeping in A Hug
reviews.text: Amazing. I don’t know how bad my sleep was until I installed the Eight. I’ve worked on sleep hygiene for 2 years and finally sleep. However, using the Eight system is an entirely new level of sleep. As a brain health and Alzheimer’s doc, this is a must for preventing brain loss.

reviews.title: Fix app please
reviews.text: The app is very buggy and this is unacceptable for an app that requires such an expensive subscription on top of an expensive product.  If you’re marking quality make software that actually works.

reviews.title: Nice but kinda buggy

reviews.title: Top 10 purchase ever
reviews.text: Eight Sleep is amazing. I've been using it now for about three years and I can't say enough good things about it. The product, the app, and customer support have all been 10 out of 10. I don't generally review apps but this one deserves it.

reviews.title: Best decision we have made for sleep!
reviews.text: My husband and I were both not sleeping great. We chalked it up to getting older and perimenopause for me. A friend suggested we try Eight Sleep as it has drastically changed how they sleep. We reluctantly made the purchase  and boy or boy were we shocked. It has drastically changed how I sleep every night. I used to wake up at around 3:00 every single night. Toss and turn and was super hot all night long. This system has allowed me to get a FULL night sleep every night. My husband’s side can be at a different temperature and it still allows me to use blankets which I love. This has been a true game changer for us and the expense is a drop in the bucket for the quality of sleep you can get at night. 10/10. Just buy it.

reviews.title: Temperature Regulation Dialed In
reviews.text: This has changed my life. Eight Sleep has found a way to keep me comfortable all night. No more waking up soaked from a heat flash one minute and then freezing 20 minutes later. The temperature regulation has been a game changer for me. Worth every penny!

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text:
I love my 8Sleep, but for the love of all things holy, why did you makr the app default to the home screen on launch, instead of the pod controls?

It's like picking up the TV remote and first having to read an AI generate essay about the shows I watched yesterday and how they are affecting my mood and how I can improve tonight's TV watching experience. Why? All I want to do is to control the product I bought.

If I want to read about my sleep performance (which by the way contradicts Apple health and whoop), then I will navigate to it. Why would you force that to be home? I love my 8Sleep, it's a remarkable product, but you get 1 star for the app. You need to hire a UX expert who designs for the user, not for a shiny feature you developed that nobody asked for and is inaccurate.

reviews.title: Great insight
reviews.text: So far we’ve been using the eight sleep since 2023. I like how it summarizes your sleep data. It tells you about your REM sleep, heart rate and more. So far I would say a lot of it has been accurate and it’s great insight to how much rest we are getting and what to look out for

reviews.title: Wish I had gotten the 8 sleep sooner
reviews.text: Has been a game changer for consistent good sleep. Love how it makes auto adjustments to improve my sleep quality. Getting the sleep data in the mornings has been really helpful too. My only regret is that I didn’t get this sooner.

reviews.title: Mandatory 200 bucks a year for privilege of using your own $2000 device
reviews.text: Doesn’t even turn on without a subscription. You have to manually turn it on. You have to unlock phone in the middle of the night to change the temperature. Hundreds of dollars every year for the privilege of having it be used as an alarm in the morning or be warm when you’re going to  bed. The paid app barely does what it’s supposed to. Without extortion price paid over and over it doesn’t do squat.

reviews.title: Too many bugs recently
reviews.text:
This app is suffering the vibe coding syndrome. Too many silly bugs recently. For instance, I would set my temperature to 66, it would not save and keep setting back to 69. Tried like 3x, restarted the app, etc.

Then my bedtime, which is the same and was set months ago, disappeared from the settings.

Many other examples like this. Hopefully soon someone will publish an open source app to control my pod.

reviews.title: Another Stupid subscription
reviews.text: The bed heats and cools as it should. I would have easily given it a five star…but you’re forced to buy one year subscription, which I did. Then, for most people, you realize the subscription is useless and you just need the bed to turn on and turn off. The rest is analytic fluff that your watch or phone or any other of the 13 gadgets around you can do. The only decent feature is a simple “bedtime” scheduling function where you can simply schedule when you’d like the bed to turn on each day instead of having to manually do it each night. But you’ve got to pay for the entire $300-$400 annual subscription to have this feature. Keep it. We’re tired of subscribing to everything. Let’s get back to the, “take my money, give me the thing, and let’s be done with this” way of life.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: No AC so summer can be brutal to try and sleep. The pod has been a life saver for a good night’s sleep.

reviews.title: Awful, Awful Support
reviews.text: My hub has been bricked in setup “updating firmware”, and the the best their support can do is *literally* one email back and forth every 24-48 hours. If you’re considering dropping $3k on one of these… buy literally anything else.

reviews.title: Exceptional product and support
reviews.text: I haven’t slept this well since I was a kid. Fantastic and easy to use software and system. So far I’m in love with the whole system. The customer service has been top notch as well. No complaints, just great sleep.

reviews.title: Loving my eight sleep
reviews.text: When I get into bed and it’s already warm, it’s like a hug from my bed, lol. Seriously I  have had issues with temperature regulation and knowing I can make my bed warmer is such a gift. One thing I would like to say is that I thought that it was going to be reading my body temperature and then make adjustments based on how hot or cold I was and it does not do that. You basically get to set the temperature when you climb in bed and then 15 minutes after it senses that you fall asleep it’s switches to another temperature and then towards the morning it switches again and you set these numbers. It does have an auto pilot mode where it will adjust things for you. But it does not read your body temperature. It reads the ambient temperature of the room. I wouldn’t say it has drastically improved my sleep, but definitely my sense of comfort. I had a very comfortable mattress and the system did make it a tiny bit less comfortable but for the most part it’s very impressive and soft and you don’t feel the tubes under you or anything like that. It’s a very high-quality system.

reviews.title: Nice but plan to spend 800.00 to 1,500 every couple of years to maintain
reviews.text:
Nice but plan to spend 860.00 to 1,700 every couple of years as it is a product that wears out. Woke up wet one night wet when the cover sprung a leak….add another $864.80 for that replacement.  Hub has gone out a couple times and now onto the third hub which is nearly 1,000.  Even with the discounts to purchase the broken aspects, it’s still expensive.  

I do enjoy the product when it’s working.  Just beware this isn’t a buy once and you’re all set.   The product needs a longer warranty.

reviews.title: I sleep way better
reviews.text: The pod and app are great and it’s the best sleep I’ve ever had on the pod 5.

reviews.title: Great technology. Horrible customer service policy
reviews.text: Really great product. I asked them to pause my account while we moved abroad one day after it auto renewed. They refused. Charged me for a full year where it was used for one day. Wouldn’t credit. Be warned and careful of your subscription renewal.

reviews.title: Recent Versions Awful for Second Users
reviews.text:
Instead of adjusting temperature by degrees, you simply have the option of the arbitrary +/- points. If both sleepers are signed in with the same login, you get the benefit of degrees control, but lose your summary on the home tab. You also cannot change your email address without losing your history. It was better before. 

Still love the mattress. The app needs a little work that would make a lot of difference, especially at this level of investment for hardware.

reviews.title: Busted
reviews.text: I turned it off this morning. Got out of bed, came back hours later to find out that had turned itself back on. This, or some other variation happens every day. Abhorrent customer service.
